scripts.pi:build:remote: sh -c 'command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "GitHub CLI (gh) is required" >&2; exit 1; }; gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "GitHub CLI is not authenticated; run: gh auth login" >&2; exit 1; }; version="${1:-next}"; gh workflow run pi-image.yml --ref main -f version="$version"; echo "Triggered remote Pi image build for $version. View it with: gh run list --workflow pi-image.yml --limit 5"' --
scripts.pi:build:remote:watch: sh -c 'command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "GitHub CLI (gh) is required" >&2; exit 1; }; gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "GitHub CLI is not authenticated; run: gh auth login" >&2; exit 1; }; version="${1:-next}"; gh workflow run pi-image.yml --ref main -f version="$version"; echo "Waiting for workflow run to appear..."; sleep 3; run_id=$(gh run list --workflow pi-image.yml --branch main --event workflow_dispatch --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq ".[0].databaseId"); test -n "$run_id" || { echo "Could not find the workflow run" >&2; exit 1; }; gh run watch "$run_id" --exit-status' --
